Shining Soul II (USA) builder

This is a collection of mods, fixes, and enhancements made by many modders all over the world. Instead of releasing my own mods as individual patches, I decided to create a Builder that makes it easier to customize your own rom. Some of these mods were for other versions of the game so I have ported them to the USA version. I've tried to give credit to each modder for their contribution, if I made a mistake please let me know. - Nelly

1. Choose the ROM

Makes a new ROM from your own unmodified USA ROM; the ROM you pick is not changed. The new ROM is 16MB, or 32MB when an option marked “Expands the ROM to 32MB” is ticked.

Waiting for the original Shining Soul II (USA) ROM.

Before you play
Back up your saves. A save made on a modded ROM may not load on the original game.
